description: This file defines the CounterFragment class, a UI fragment for displaying and animating a counter in an Android wearable app.

classes.name: CounterFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays a numeric counter with simple up/down animation.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, initializes drawables and the counter text view, sets initial counter value, and starts the animation.

methods.name: startAnimation
methods.description: Sets up a TimerTask to periodically toggle the drawable on the counter to animate.

methods.name: setCounter
methods.description: Sets the counter text to a string value.

methods.name: setCounter
methods.description: Sets the counter text based on an integer, defaulting to zero if negative.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Cleans up the timer when the fragment is detached.
